reason: POST /api/auth/login request body (input only): verified with argon2 and never echoed; the endpoint answers 204 or problem+json.
POST /api/auth/password/setup request body (input only): the single-use setup/reset token from the mailed link; only its sha-256 is looked up, never echoed.
POST /api/auth/password/setup request body (input only): the new password, hashed with argon2id; the endpoint answers 204 or problem+json.

POST /api/me/mfa/enroll/start response (docs/contracts/mfa.md): the NEW pending TOTP key, shown once to the signed-in user themselves for manual entry in their authenticator app (also inside otpauthUri/qrPng); stored only AES-256-GCM-encrypted, never returned again, redacted from logs.

POST /api/attendance/scan request body (input only, docs/contracts/attendance.md › Scan, ADR 009 §2): the short-lived signed QR code the phone's camera read from /punch#<token>; verified with HMAC and never echoed (the answer is the kiosk label and the scan instant), redacted from logs (req.body.token).

POST /api/sso/clients and POST /api/sso/clients/:id/rotate-secret responses (docs/contracts/sso.md › Administration): the connected app's NEW client secret, shown ONCE to the administrator to paste into the app's configuration; stored only AES-256-GCM-sealed (OIDC_KEY subkey), never returned again, redacted from logs (*.clientSecret).
